ideas.idea: Make the moorings page deliver sizes and seasonal prices as text, matching its description
ideas.why: The description promises sizes and seasonal prices but the page only says 'Prices start at £40 a night', so adding real content helps readers and machines.

ideas.idea: Show the FAQ answers as visible text on the home page
ideas.why: The FAQ answers exist only inside JSON-LD in index.astro, and structured data should match visible content.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Organization markup with phone number to the contact page
ideas.why: The contact page has a phone number in plain text and no markup, so this is a concrete, repo-specific improvement.

ideas.idea: Add meta charset and viewport to the head
ideas.why: Base.astro lacks both, which is accurate, but it's standard boilerplate that applies to nearly any site.
Accurate since Base.astro has a bare slot in body, but it's a universal semantic-HTML tip with little discoverability effect.

ideas.idea: Set `site` in an Astro config and generate canonicals and sitemap from it
ideas.why: There is no astro.config, harbor.example is hardcoded in the layout, robots.txt and sitemap, and a single source of truth would also fix the canonical problem.
The sitemap has no dates, but this is a common optional enhancement with little effect on a three-page site.

ideas.idea: Link from home page body text to /moorings
ideas.why: The home page links to moorings only via nav, but in-content links are a broadly applicable tip with small impact here.

ideas.idea: Give the newsletter form an action
ideas.why: The form has no action, which is accurate, but it's a functional matter rather than something that affects finding or understanding the site.
